title: Spring Boots
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Armor piece |rarity = r |id = SPRING_BOOTS |reforgeable = y |enchantable = y |auctionable = y |tradeable = y |museum = yes |museum_xp = 0 |museum_category = special |merchant = Bingo |buy = {{Bingo Points|150}} }} '''Spring Boots''' are {{Rare}} [[Boots]] that give the player the ability to jump extremely high. They can be purchased from the [[Bingo_Shop|{{Aqua|Bingo Shop}}]] for {{Bingo Points|150}} once the player has reached {{BingoText|1}}. == Obtaining == === Shop Purchase === '''Spring Boots''' can be purchased from the [[Bingo_Shop|{{Aqua|Bingo Shop}}]] for {{Bingo Points|150}} once the player has reached {{BingoText|1}}. == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Boots |rarity = rare |special_effect = {{Ench|Feather Falling XX}}
Increases how high you can fall before taking fall damage by {{Green|20}} and reduces fall damage by {{Green|100%}}. |item_ability_name = To the moon! |item_ability_activation = SNEAK |item_ability_description = Charge your jump by sneaking. The longer you sneak, the higher you will jump. }} == Trivia == *This is the first (and currently only) item to have {{Ench|Feather Falling XX}} (20). *The '''Spring Boots''' are useful in the [[The Catacombs - Floor VII|Floor 7]] boss room, allowing you to easily get the crystals in phase 1. [[Mage|Mages]] and [[Berserker|Berserkers]] are recommended to use this method as using [[Bonzo's Staff]] or [[Jerry-chine Gun]] would consume a lot of {{Stat|Mana}} and {{Stat|vitality}}, which is highly server dependent. *The '''Spring Boots''' can be used in [[Dungeon Traps|Trap Room]] to "jump" high and skip the parkour. *These are one of the only non-cosmetic armor pieces that do not grant any stats. *Until the [[Artist's Abode]] update, '''Spring Boots''' were '''Co-op Soulbound''' and could not be sold, auctioned, or traded with anyone other than Co-op members. This presented a very unique problem for Bingo players looking to sell their '''Spring Boots'''; meaning the seller would join the buyer's Co-op, purchase the '''Spring Boots''' from the [[Bingo]] shop, then trade them to their new Co-op member, usually via a middleman. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2024/July 31|'''Spring Boots''' are no longer {{Soulbound|Co-op}}.}} |beta= {{History|2021/November 29|link=none|[[File:Spring Boots.png|26px]] Added '''Spring Boots'''.}} {{History|2021/December 1|link=none|'''Spring Boots''' become obtainable.}} {{History|2024/August 6|'''Spring Boots''' are no longer {{Soulbound|Co-op}}.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Events/Bingo}} {{Nav/Armors}}
